LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_OpenTip: Show this colony's confirmed endings, milestones, completed research, verified intervals and recording notes along one save branch (read-only). Nothing is guessed, and branches are never added together.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_BranchMissingNotice: The branch picked earlier could not be found again, so the default branch is shown.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_LoadFailed: The chronicle could not be read. Errors are written to the log.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_Empty: No dated entries match this branch and filter.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_SummaryLine: Showing {0} of {1} entries · {2} records on this branch
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_OtherBranchEndingsNotice: {0} endings happened on other branches and are not shown here.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_AmbiguousEndingsNotice: {0} endings cannot be placed on a single branch yet and are not shown here.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_OmittedCapNotice: {0} entries are left out to keep the list manageable (the latest research first, then the oldest intervals). Endings, milestones and recording notes are kept first.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_TipDepartedMax: If this ending was recorded more than once, the largest departed count is shown.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_ResearchUnloadedNote: This research project is not loaded now, so its saved name is shown.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_Gap_MissingParent: The checkpoint at day {0} names a parent that is not in the records, so this branch's earlier history is incomplete.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_Gap_UnprovenSave: The save at day {0} has no checkpoint (saved before this MOD was added, or with recording off), so its place in the lineage is not proven.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_Gap_CarriedSpan: No new checkpoint from day {0} to day {1}: the later save kept the older one unchanged.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_Gap_LateLiveStart: Some statistics recorded in play only start at day {0} (MOD added mid-game, a statistic turned on, or its recording restarted).
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_Gap_NotCounted: Between day {0} and day {1} some running totals were not recorded without interruption, so no change is shown for them.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_Gap_ArchiveUnavailable: The detailed checkpoint values of day {0} were archived, and the archive could not be read.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_Gap_ResearchCap: The list of completed research reached its size limit; later completions are missing.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_TipHistorySample: The day comes from the save's history graph, which keeps one sample every half day; the exact moment is not recorded.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_TipInterval: Change between two directly linked checkpoints. When within this span each change happened is not known.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_UndatedSubtitle: There is evidence that these endings happened, but no in-game day can be proven for them, so they are kept off the timeline.
